pages.title: Summit Uplift
pages.text: Summit cliff uplift is configurable and smoothed. Peaks no longer rise abruptly at a fixed boundary; stronger mountain terrain gradually enters the high summit region so shoulders, peaks, and surrounding land connect naturally.

pages.title: What You Can Adjust
pages.text: You can adjust peak height, blend ratios, overall mountain uplift, falloff distance, and central plateau size. Changes affect only new chunks; very large differences can leave seams at old chunk borders.
